s1.syndrome_frame: Acute onset of fever, skin lesions, and chest pain with cardiac involvement
salient_findings: Sudden appearance of skin lesions at the base of the penis
Development of fever, chest pain, and shortness of breath
Vesicular and umbilicated lesions on genitals with lymphadenomegaly
key_facts: 12-year history of well-controlled HIV
Past medical history of treated early latent syphilis
Recent sexual activity with multiple male partners
Low-grade fever initially, then high fever up to 39°C
Chest pain without irradiation and shortness of breath
Vesicular and umbilicated lesions on genitals
Small lymphadenomegaly in the groin area
Hemodynamically stable with continuous anterior chest pain
Elevated high-sensitivity cardiac troponin
ECG showed sinus tachycardia with elevated PR segment
Echocardiography showed hypokinetic left ventricle with EF 50%
Cardiac MRI showed slightly increased global T1 and T2 mapping values
